name: collagen type I alpha 1 chain

function.text: COL1A1 encodes collagen alpha-1(I) chain. Annotated molecular activities include extracellular matrix structural constituent conferring tensile strength and protease binding. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and osteoblast differentiation.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to COL1A1-related Ehlers-Danlos syndrome (autosomal dominant); Caffey disease (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include COL1A1::PDGFB fusion-associated uterine sarcoma; Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans, fibrosarcomatous. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
